Fellow distance-users,

I would like to estimate density and detection probabilities with
DISTANCE. My data consist of 14 breeding bird survey routes in the se
US - 50 stops/routes, 3 min/stop, unlimited distance. I'm ignoring
route as a covariate. Eventually I would like to regress density at a
point with land use data. I know DISTANCE does these types of analyses
but having gone through the manual several times I still can't find how
I get to step 1: how to code data. Is there a Distance for Dummies
manual out there or can get someone give me a few pointers on how to get
started?

Thanks,

Jeff
